description: Committee recommends moving $136,246.75 to close smart water meter project.
Project installed smart meters for accurate water billing.

chips.text: Councillor Timon questioned high water bills and reserve balance.

Specific balance of Waterworks Capital Projects Reserve was not provided.

description: Committee recommends Council consider developing a Customer Experience Strategy.
Strategy aims to improve city services and resident satisfaction.
Proposed strategy development costs $250,000 in 2026-2027 budget.

chips.text: Councillor Davies expressed budget concerns due to potential 9% tax increase.
Administration could not provide definitive FTE numbers for strategy development.
2024 Civic Survey showed a 15% drop in residents feeling city prioritizes customer service.
Strategy aims to improve identification and removal of accessibility barriers.

description: North Kiwanis washroom pilot reduced vandalism by 67%.
Full-time supervision costs $254,600 annually, preventing 51 incidents.
Pilot ends this year without further funding for supervision.

chips.text: Washroom is frequented by females and children, who feel safe due to staff.
Whether partners like the BID knew about the meeting was not clear.
Administration will explore washroom access options in Pleasant Hill and Riversdale.
